attribution: Numeric financial facts and institutional accounting context derived from NSCC Consolidated Financial Statements 2026, original source linked. No audit opinion text, personal signatures, logos or complete PDF pages are republished.
limits: Budget is the college statement budget, not the provincial departmental budget. It is not labelled an audited actual.
The prior-year column is comparative information in the 2026 statement and may reflect reclassification.
The college plus Foundation reporting perimeter and recognition basis differ from a departmental appropriation or cash-payment list.
Do not subtract the provincial NSCC program forecast from the college provincial-operating-grant line to allege a shortfall; funding-category and recognition bridges are missing.
Aggregate salary expenses are institutional totals; no individual employee, student or donor data is projected.
Source dashes remain null; no net-Foundation dash has been treated as zero.
Stock balances are not spending flows; opening/closing surplus cannot be added to revenue or expenses. Subtotals and annual-result balances overlap component rows and are not universally additive.
No assertion about funding adequacy, legal compliance or service outcomes is made.

recognitionContext.relatedPartySummary: The notes identify the provincial Advanced Education department as a funder. This is source evidence of an institutional funding relationship, not a specific payment transaction.
recognitionContext.summary: Government contributions become revenue after authorization and eligibility criteria are met; funding with unmet stipulations is deferred. Recognized revenue is not necessarily cash received in the same year.
